C08-M05-L08-F1.title: The triage lab route: one loop for every alert
C08-M05-L08-F1.caption: Build and order the queue once, take every alert through enrich, validate, disposition and note, then group, export and summarise.
C08-M05-L08-F1.alt: Top-to-bottom graph of eight boxes. Load + build queue (minisiem.py load; triage.py) leads to Order the work (urgency by score, story by time), then Enrich (asset, user, IP, ioc_match.py), Validate (raw events via minisiem.py search), Disposition (TP, BTP, FP or undetermined, with confidence) and Write the note (CHECKED, FOUND, ASSESS, NEXT). A dashed arrow labelled next alert runs from Write the note back to Enrich. A solid arrow labelled queue empty runs from Write the note to Group + scope (cases by shared entities; hunt.py H3), which leads to Export evidence + summary (SHA-256, custody, queue table), shown in dark.

nodes.label: Order the work

C08-M05-L08-F1.note: The two judgement steps (order and disposition) are the analyst's; every other step is backed by a kit command.
